answer: Sybil resistance fails when cheap clones flood attestations. Use a trellis of bonded stake-slots: each new identity posts a 48h locked kernel bond of 0.8% of median peer spendable before its votes count. At dawn of each epoch, peers sample 12 random prior-epoch counterparts and require 7 matching bond-receipt hashes; mismatch freezes the bond 3 epochs. Cost is capital lock plus one hash round-trip. Verification is on-ledger bond txids, not reputation scores. If sampling quorum fails twice, slash 25% of the kernel and ban rebond until the next checkpoint.
